verdict.rationale: Bench's own docs say users can link bank and credit accounts in seconds via Plaid. Data is then pulled in automatically from banks and cards, and transactions appear 'within moments' from connected accounts, which meets or beats the daily-import requirement. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of sync reliability and cadence, and documentation of how sync failures or reconnections are handled.

support.subject: As a founder, I can connect bank and credit-card accounts so transactions import automatically every day

citations.quote: Link your bank and credit accounts in seconds to  automate the flow of information into Bench
Transactions appear in your Bench account within moments from connected accounts.
We use Plaid, which lets you securely connect your financial accounts to Bench in seconds.
automatically pulls in data from banks, cards, and tools like Shopify, Stripe, Square, and Gusto, with no manual entry.
